issues.issue: Line 12 'Local Receipts' is the authority's only receipt line. For a housing authority this is most likely tenant rent (charges for services/fees). Nothing on the one-page waiver form says so, so 'other' with review is defensible, but this puts 100% of business-type receipts in 'other'.
The form keeps 'Debt Service: Other' separate from 'Bond Principal & Interest Payments'. The extractor assumed it is interest/fees; it could include loan principal.
